curated-gf-tangerine-gf-jost: Tangerine's low, hand-drawn curves lean back and relax. Jost carries a longer read in broad-gapped sans letters with a uniform stroke, steady and unfussy, though it's happiest when the copy stays brief.
curated-gf-tangerine-gf-red-hat-mono: Red Hat Mono sets every letter in a fixed-width box. Over a longer passage, its ballpoint-pen stroke and slow, measured beats feel precise and technical, which is why Tangerine's loose handwriting above it matters, since the monospace isn't meant for long paragraphs.
curated-gf-tangerine-plus-jakarta-sans: Relaxed and inviting, Tangerine writes in low, loose strokes. Plus Jakarta Sans sits beside it taller and more precise, a monoline sans-serif that makes the handwriting feel even looser, say on a road trip scrapbook.
curated-gf-the-girl-next-door-roboto-sla: Big, hooked letters with barely any ascender room mark The Girl Next Door, drawn in one unshaded stroke. Roboto Slab follows with structured slab-serif lines and open throats, and that exactness is the pair's strongest quality.
curated-gf-the-nautigal-gf-almarai: Graceful and inviting, The Nautigal looks like neon tubing bent into snug, casual letters. Almarai sits below in a sans-serif with a never-swelling line and open curves, a plainer neighbor that suits brief copy best.
curated-gf-tilt-prism-gf-maiden-orange: Maiden Orange packs tall serif letters tightly, like matchsticks in a box, with traditional authority. Tilt Prism pushes back, its glyphs drawn with one tip and strangely bold, so the two feel like a stern elder beside a showman.
curated-gf-tiro-bangla-gf-noto-sans-vai: Noto Sans Vai reads in solid, approachable blocks, with generous openings where its curves meet the stem. And Tiro Bangla's serif strokes, swinging between fat and slender, give the page a dignified, classic voice above it.
curated-gf-trade-winds-gf-biz-udpmincho: Bold, swaggering display letters with moderate contrast. BIZ UDPMincho follows in a refined serif with mild thicks and wide exits, so Trade Winds does the shouting while the body stays measured and suits brief copy.
curated-gf-train-one-gf-lilex: Expressive and wirelike, Train One drifts along in unshaded strokes with a slow, drawn-out cadence. Lilex answers in fixed-width monospace with loose tracking, and a longer passage would feel precise, technical and deliberately spaced out.
curated-gf-triodion-gf-oxygen: Commanding and broad-shouldered, Triodion could front a brand guidelines deck without blinking, its open counters carrying real weight. Oxygen's sans-serif lowercase runs nearly as tall as its capitals, and a longer passage reads clean and contemporary.
